Whether you're traveling with your dog or cat, our pet-friendly policy is designed to keep tails wagging and your stay worry-free.
Pet-Friendly Overview Pets Welcome: My Place Hotels welcome domesticated dogs and cats.
While all hotels follow our brand pet policy, some may have property-specific restrictions.
Number of Pets: Guests may bring up to two pets per room, with a combined maximum weight of 80 pounds.
Service Animals: Service animals are not considered pets and are always welcome under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).
Pet Fees Each hotel charges a pet fee, which may vary by location.
My Place Hotels is Pet Friendly!
Embark on an adventure with your four-legged friends at any of our 70+ My Place Hotels locations, where flexibility meets comfort for both you and your pets.
With a heartfelt invitation extended to dogs and cats alike, we ensure that your companions are not just allowed, but truly welcomed.
The My Place Hotels pet policy is crafted to guarantee a delightful experience for your pets at every location, mirroring the joy and relaxation you expect from your stay.
Plus, with our in-room full kitchens, you can keep a stash of pet treats handy to spoil your furry friends!
🐾 Introducing My Pet Points 🐾 When you stay with your pet, you’ll earn points just for bringing them along.
That’s right… Your pets now earn you points, too.
Every eligible stay that includes a pet fee helps you build toward future rewards through Stay Rewarded®.
